title: Produce the authoritative capability ledger and close the rule-procedure readiness ledger
description:
Regenerate the capability ledger from the CLAUSE-COMPLETE corpus and prove
closure. Runs after 19.1.1 (clause IR), 19.1.4 (in-band readiness) and 19.6.1
(full corpus migration).

Required steps:
  1. Regenerate capabilities from the clause-complete corpus.
  2. Compare against the bootstrap ledger (19.5.1).
  3. Discover any requirements previously invisible, and explain each delta.
  4. Prove every deterministic source clause maps to an implemented capability or
     an explicit approved boundary.

Also closes the rule-procedure readiness ledger: 16 partial rule procedures; 2
unimplemented rest procedures; 10 design-blocked rule families; 7 external
clauses; 794 engine-pending magic-item clauses.

Rule-gap to capability mapping (snapshot; regenerate rather than trust):
  armor-guidance / AC derivation            engine:F8, engine:F9
  casting-a-spell saving-throw item bonuses engine:F8
  charges                                   engine:F5
  conflict                                  engine:F1, F3, F5
  crafting / lifestyle / profession /
    researching / self-sufficiency /
    selling treasure / training             engine:F10
  experience points / total level           engine:F10 or a verified existing progression bead
  special weapons                           engine:F2, engine:F9
  suffocating                               engine:F6, engine:F7
  weapon properties                         engine:F2, F5, F9
  wizard spellbook copying                  engine:F4, engine:F10
  short rest                                engine:F7
  long rest                                 engine:F7, with F4/F5 reset integration

Design-blocked families claiming existing owners — inspect and verify scope, do
NOT auto-create duplicates: channel divinity, class features, extra attack, hit
points and hit dice, multiclassing, multiclass proficiency bonus, spellcasting,
unarmored defense, customizing a background, feats.

GREEN DEFINITION — shared verbatim by 19.1.4, 19.1.5, 19.4.5 and 19.5.12. A
clause is green ONLY when all eight hold:
  1. The complete source clause has been identified.
  2. Every deterministic branch is projected.
  3. All source and derived fields are provenanced.
  4. Every required capability is identified.
  5. The engine implementation exists.
  6. An executable conformance scenario proves the intended outcome.
  7. Runtime lookup can find the canonical clause.
  8. Unsupported portions fail closed.
A representation reference that merely RESOLVES to an existing object is not
green. The Opus amended magic-item pass proved reference integrity but explicitly
did NOT prove the semantic appropriateness of every free-form effect.

COUNT HYGIENE: every number in this bead is a SNAPSHOT at commit 4384f25. The
generated ledger/predicate is authoritative. No acceptance test may require a
hand-copied number (e.g. 391, 399, 77, 79).
design:
The 16-partial / 2-unimplemented / 10-design-blocked / 7-external figures come
from docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/2026-07-06-o9bd-18-7-8-execution-boundary-
classification.md and -3-engine-coverage-inventory.md. Those PREDATE the closure
of both eshyra-o9bd.18.7.8 and eshyra-2n1t, and rule records at 4384f25 carry
only {text, tableRefs, skillsByAbility} — there is no in-band rule disposition to
check them against. Treat the July 6 numbers as historical, never as current.
acceptance_criteria:
- The authoritative ledger is regenerated from the clause-complete corpus, and the diff against the bootstrap ledger is explained requirement by requirement.
- Every previously invisible requirement discovered by the diff has an owning bead under eshyra-olc5.
- Every ledger entry is green under the shared eight-point definition, or has an approved explicit house-rule/design dependency.
- No "missing but untracked" status exists anywhere in the ledger.
- Every claimed owning bead reference resolves in the real bd database, with its open/closed status recorded.
- Each design-blocked family is genuinely covered by a verified existing decision (ADR 0018 for multiclassing; the D2 creation-variant decision for feats/customizing-a-background) or gets new scope — never a duplicate.
- The three explicit SRD ambiguities are regression-tested as UNRESOLVED under eshyra-jhpt.6/.7.
notes:
Bead-writing contract (plan §VI) — this bead must state: exact scope membership
(explicit records/clauses or a deterministic query that enumerates them), root
cause, required invariant, source evidence, pack evidence, engine boundary,
regression predicate + committed assertions, generated outputs, no-repeat alias
list, and completion proof. "Fix the examples above" is not acceptable scope;
close the whole semantic class and reconcile exact membership.
*** GREEN DEFINITION REVISED (2026-07-25) — SUPERSEDES the 8-point version ***
DECISION: where structured pack data is a DIRECT INPUT to deterministic
execution, the pack contract and the reference engine are ONE co-designed
system. The pack defines what the engine must execute; the reference engine
proves the representation is sufficient and unambiguous. Freezing the pack
first would preserve a separation that does not exist in practice.

A deterministic clause that feeds engine execution is GREEN only when all nine
hold:
  1. Complete source-clause identification.
  2. Clause-complete structured representation.
  3. Complete field provenance.
  4. Explicit capability requirements.
  5. A provider-neutral engine implementation exists.
  6. Reference-engine conformance tests exercise the PACK representation.
  7. Correct tool exposure and state mutation.
  8. Fail-closed behavior for unsupported input.
  9. Successful replay / deterministic equivalence where applicable.

A clause is NOT green merely because the pack appears to contain enough data;
the reference implementation must demonstrate that it actually does. A
representation reference that merely RESOLVES to an existing object is not
green — the Opus amended magic-item pass proved reference integrity but
explicitly did NOT prove semantic appropriateness of free-form effects.

AT RE-FREEZE THERE MUST BE ZERO ENGINE-PENDING DETERMINISTIC CLAUSES. The only
permissible non-green clauses are four approved categories:
  * genuine source ambiguity routed to campaign rulings;
  * intentionally model-adjudicated material;
  * external content unavailable in the SRD;
  * explicitly deferred non-deterministic house-rule behavior.
Each must be explicitly represented in-band, carry its alternatives and
campaign-ruling requirement, and fail CLOSED.

WHY (audit evidence): the 2026-07-24 findings were structures that looked
plausible in isolation but failed as executable inputs — alternative damage
modes stored as parallel damage, recharge triggers read as reset periods,
partial saves treated as complete, legendary actions with no budget or cost,
option mechanics hoisted onto parent features, typed records missing
branching/timing/termination. A completed reference implementation forces these
to surface: a dragon-breath scenario cannot pass without half-damage handling;
a legendary-creature scenario cannot pass without a budget; a versatile attack
cannot execute without a discriminated alternative.

CONSEQUENCE FOR SEQUENCING: eshyra-olc5 is no longer a downstream project that
may stay open after eshyra-o9bd closes. Its reference-implementation
certification gates eshyra-o9bd.19.6.1 and therefore the formal re-freeze in
eshyra-o9bd.14.
